title: Wrongly reading model stream answer resulting in a duplication of tool-calls with same tool id
description: ### Description After some hours of investigations, I finally get to the bottom of this that drove me crazy. I'm thinking this bug could be a "source bug" of many other issues. # Context ## Provider I've used Scaleway Generative APIs https://www.scaleway.com/en/docs/ai-data/generative-apis/quickstart/ https://www.scaleway.com/en/generative-apis/ ## Models concerned At least: - meta/llama-3.1-70b-instruct:fp8 - meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct:fp8 But other models could be impacted if they answer the same way. I expect this problem to be non-provider related but model related. You should be able to reproduce it with any Llama 3.1 provider. # Possible other issues with same underlying bug - https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/3872 I think it may have other issues related but I haven't checked deeply. # How to reproduce the bug? Use the Weather Demo Chatbot: https://vercel.com/templates/next.js/nextjs-ai-chatbot With a provider providing a Llama 3.1 8B or 70B # Description of the bug In the UI : 2 weather widgets are displayed but one has crashed. We have a React error indicating that there is a duplicate key for 2 components. On the Provider side: we have an error `'{"object":"error","message":"This model only supports single tool-calls at once!","type":"BadRequestError","param":null,"code":400}'` These are both resulting errors but **its not the source of the problem**. To my investigation point, I think the bug concerns only the "stream features" like "streamText" # Explanation of the bug I've narrowed it to the first call to the provider. Call done: ``` curl -X POST "$PROVIDER/v1/chat/completions" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"model":"llama-3.1-8b-instruct","parallel_tool_calls":false,"temperature":0,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You can use tools to anwser user request."},{"role":"user","content":"Give me the latest news on ai"}],"tools":[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"searchGoogle","description":"Search on the web using Google Search","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"the query to search"}},"required":["query"],"additionalProperties":false,"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"}}}],"tool_choice":"auto","stream":true,"stream_options":{"include_usage":true}}' ``` The 2024-12-02T18:16:30: type: 'tool-call', 2024-12-02T18:16:30: toolCallType: 'function', 2024-12-02T18:16:30: toolCallId: 'chatcmpl-tool-3d480d27469f4941808ae5f8db4c50fa', 2024-12-02T18:16:30: toolName: 'searchGoogle', 2024-12-02T18:16:30: args: '{"query": "latest news on ai"}' 2024-12-02T18:16:30: } ``` # Explanation of the log flow The tool-call is streamed from the model but at a given point, the arguments became a valid parsableJSON and then the tool-call is send. Just after that, another chunk is parsed with an empty argument: `mappedToolCalls [ { index: 0, function: { arguments: '' } } ]` This results in the same tool-call be sent again. This then trigger a lot of different kind of bugs afterward. # Ideas of resolution - stop expecting that the tool-call is finished just because the args are parseable and find something more trustworthy (I think it would be the best solution) - use a simple security so that a tool-call with the same id can't be send twice down the pipe Don't hesitate to ask if anything is unclear. I'll be glad to help! ### Code example _No response_ ### AI provider @ai-sdk/openai v1.0.5 ### Additional context Version of packages: ai: v4.0.9 @ai-sdk/openai: v1.0.5
